# Two Top Jobs

<!-- STEP id="britains-two-hats" -->
## Head of State, Head of Government

Many countries have two top jobs: the **Head of State**, the formal head of the country, and the **Head of Government**, who leads the government.

The United Kingdom is a **constitutional monarchy**, with a Monarch as Head of State.

<!-- STEP id="indias-two-hats" -->
## India and Canada

India has no monarch: the President is Head of State and the Prime Minister is Head of Government.

Canada also has the Monarch as Head of State, and the Prime Minister leads its government. A Governor-General is appointed by the Monarch on the advice of the Prime Minister.

Tap a country to compare.
